label: USE CASE 10
title: How the Instagram Reels Feed Works

scenes.text: You open Instagram for two minutes, and somehow, an hour disappears. [1] Every reel feels like it was picked just for you. [2] Let's break down how the Reels feed decides what you see.

Here's what happens every time you scroll. [1] The system gathers thousands of possible reels, from accounts you follow, and ones you don't. [2] It filters out anything you've already seen, or that breaks the rules. [3] A model predicts, for each reel, how likely you are to watch, like, share or skip it. [4] It ranks them by those predictions, [5] and shows you the top ones, with some variety mixed in.

So which signals matter? [1] Watch time, especially watching till the end, or rewatching. [2] Shares, because sending a reel to a friend is a strong signal. [3] Saves, which say this is worth coming back to. [4] And skips, because scrolling past quickly tells it you're not interested.

The heart of it is prediction. [1] For every reel, the model estimates the chance you'll engage with it. [2] It learns from billions of past views, [3] combines many signals into one score, [4] and keeps updating as you scroll.

data.definition: Estimating how likely you are to watch, like, share or skip each reel.

scenes.text: So why do you see accounts you don't follow? [1] A following feed only shows people you chose. [2] A recommended feed can show anyone, and that's how small creators can suddenly go viral.

So what does this mean for creators? [1] Hook viewers in the first two seconds, so they don't skip. [2] Make reels worth watching to the end, or sharing with a friend. [3] And post consistently, so the system learns who enjoys your content.

Here's a common myth. [1] People think there's one secret trick, like a special hashtag, that guarantees views. [2] There isn't. The ranking combines many signals, and mostly rewards reels that people genuinely watch, share and save.

data.myth: One secret trick, like a special hashtag, guarantees views.
data.fact: Ranking combines many signals and rewards reels people genuinely watch, share and save.
